description: Source-backed timing annotations for three existing Wikibooks recipes. Original recipe records and the 30-dinner core are preserved. Source text is CC BY-SA 4.0, attributed to Wikibooks contributors; only number formatting and a range upper bound are normalized. Each annotation is bound to the captured recipe hash and cites the reviewed page revision.

coreDinner.evidence: Selected for the reviewed 30-dinner core. Original source ingredients, amounts, servings and directions are preserved; egg dishes are light main dishes, with no nutritional-completeness claim.

dinnerRole.evidence: Reviewed as a main dinner or light main dish rather than a sauce, dessert, or garnish. Source title: Chickpea Omelette

diets.vegan.evidence: Reviewed complete ingredients: no listed animal-derived ingredients. This is ingredient-based diet suitability, not allergy certification. 1 cup chickpea flour | 1 teaspoon baking powder | Salt | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 cup soy milk or water | 1 tablespoon olive oil

diets.vegetarian.evidence: Reviewed complete ingredients and method: no listed meat or fish. Product composition and cross-contact are not certified. 1 cup chickpea flour | 1 teaspoon baking powder | Salt | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 cup soy milk or water | 1 tablespoon olive oil

diets.gluten_free.evidence: The captured source does not establish verified gluten-free suitability for all prepared ingredients or serving additions. No certification inferred. 1 cup chickpea flour | 1 teaspoon baking powder | Salt | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 cup soy milk or water | 1 tablespoon olive oil

diets.low_carb.evidence: Unknown: no reviewed nutritional values or agreed carbohydrate threshold are present in the captured source. No macros or dietary threshold inferred.

equipment.evidence: Required cooking appliances reviewed from the unchanged method; pots, pans, knives and ordinary utensils are not appliance exclusions. Heat up a skillet on medium heat and add the olive oil. Spread the oil across the pan and let it heat up a little. | Pour the batter into the skillet. Cook until bubbles form in the middle. Then, carefully flip using a spatula.

ingredients.evidence: Reviewed source ingredient names and amounts without rewriting or silently resolving alternatives. Unknown/as-needed amounts remain unresolved. 1 cup chickpea flour | 1 teaspoon baking powder | Salt | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 cup soy milk or water | 1 tablespoon olive oil
